name: Basic Mathematics
description: Mathematics for Ordinary Secondary Education, Form I-IV. Covers number systems, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, statistics, and mensuration.

subtopics.title: Meaning of Mathematics
outcomes: Describe Mathematics as a science of patterns and numbers

subtopics.title: Branches of Mathematics
outcomes: Identify branches of Mathematics (Arithmetic, Algebra, Geometry, Statistics)
Explain the scope of each branch of Mathematics

subtopics.title: Relationship between Mathematics and other subjects
outcomes: Relate Mathematics to Science, Economics, and Geography
Identify how Mathematics is applied in other disciplines

subtopics.title: Importance of Mathematics
outcomes: Explain the importance of Mathematics in daily life
Discuss the importance of Mathematics in various careers

subtopics.title: Concept of Numbers
outcomes: Classify natural numbers, whole numbers, and integers
Apply numbers in daily life situations

subtopics.title: Rational Numbers
outcomes: Define rational numbers with examples (fractions, terminating and recurring decimals)
Represent rational numbers on a number line

subtopics.title: Irrational Numbers
outcomes: Define irrational numbers with examples (√2, π)
Distinguish between rational and irrational numbers

subtopics.title: Real Numbers
outcomes: Describe the real number system as the union of rational and irrational numbers
Represent real numbers on the number line

subtopics.title: Inequalities in Real Numbers
outcomes: Represent and solve simple inequalities using <, >, ≤, ≥ on a number line

subtopics.title: Absolute Value of a Real Number
outcomes: Calculate |x| for given real numbers and solve simple problems involving absolute value

subtopics.title: Meaning of Approximations
outcomes: Explain the importance of approximation in real life

subtopics.title: Rounding off Numbers
outcomes: Round off numbers to the nearest whole number, tens, and hundreds
Round off numbers to a given number of decimal places

subtopics.title: Significant Figures
outcomes: State the rules for significant figures
Round numbers to a given number of significant figures

subtopics.title: Approximations in Calculations
outcomes: Apply approximation in everyday estimation and calculations
Use approximations to estimate values of numeric expressions

subtopics.title: Ratios
outcomes: Express quantities as ratios and simplify ratios
Solve real-life sharing problems using ratios

subtopics.title: Proportions
outcomes: Solve problems involving direct and inverse proportion (recipes, speed/time)

subtopics.title: Algebraic Expressions
outcomes: Define algebraic expression, term, coefficient, and variable
Form algebraic expressions from word statements
Simplify algebraic expressions by collecting like terms

subtopics.title: Algebraic Equations
outcomes: Form linear equations from word problems
Solve linear equations in one unknown

subtopics.title: Linear Simultaneous Equations
outcomes: Solve simultaneous equations using the elimination method
Solve simultaneous equations using the substitution method

subtopics.title: Solution of Inequalities with One Unknown
outcomes: Solve simple linear inequalities in one unknown
Represent solutions of inequalities on a number line

subtopics.title: Basic Concepts of Coordinate Geometry

subtopics.title: Gradient of a Straight Line
